entities.summary: Tariq Masood Niazi was a Pakistani field hockey player who represented Pakistan at the highest level during the 1960s. He was born in Mianwali, Pakistan. Niazi completed his graduation from the University of Karachi and later earned a post-graduate degree in International Relations, also from the University of Karachi.
